description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the face liveness detection operation DetectLivingFace
description_zh: 本文为您介绍人脸活体检测DetectLivingFace的语法及示例
name: DetectLivingFace

element_fields.description_en:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image table). A maximum of 10 elements are supported, meaning up to 10 images can be detected simultaneously. We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or OSS links in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> For this operation, the system automatically converts OSS link addresses to internal network addresses before downloading files, so calling this operation does not incur OSS traffic fees.
element_fields.description_zh:
待检测的图像URL地址。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个图片检测任务结构体（image表）。最多支持10个元素，即同时最多对10张图片进行检测。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。

> 对于该接口，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费。

element_fields.description_en:
The Base64-encoded string of the image. When both this parameter and the URL parameter are specified, the URL parameter takes precedence.
For information about Base64 encoding of files, see [File Base64 processing](~~468191~~).
